hypothesis: Holding SPY with a weight of min(1, 15 percent / trailing 21-session realized volatility), the remainder in BIL, rebalanced every 5 sessions with a 0.10 weight no-trade band, has a higher Sharpe ratio than buy-and-hold SPY after a fixed 10 bps round-trip cost on traded weight, and a smaller maximum drawdown than a static SPY/BIL mix holding the same average SPY weight, on identical dates.
economic_motivation: Volatility clusters while expected returns do not rise proportionally, so reducing exposure when realized volatility is high has historically improved risk-adjusted returns of equity indices (Moreira and Muir 2017, 'Volatility-Managed Portfolios'). The rule never uses price direction, trades a few times a quarter, and caps exposure at 100 percent (no leverage).
distinct_from_consumed: research_reset_trend_20260908 tested a binary price-direction filter (close vs 60 sessions ago) on six ETFs and explicitly excluded volatility targeting. This contract uses no price-direction signal, a continuous weight, and SPY/BIL only. A long-horizon price-trend filter was considered and excluded as a variant of the consumed trend hypothesis.
acquisition: Daily SIP bars for SPY and BIL, 2016-01-04 through 2025-12-31, adjustment=all, acquired once into a hash-manifested artifact before registration; any row dated in 2026 is refused before prices are read.
availability_check: 2026-10-25 timestamp-only request: SPY and BIL each return 2514 daily bars from 2016-01-04 to 2025-12-31; no price was printed or analysed.

volatility.returns: daily log returns of adjusted close

decision: After the close of session t, using closes through t only.
exit: Regular-session open of session t+6 (next rebalance); periods never overlap.
allocation: SPY weight w as defined; BIL weight 1 - w. No leverage, no shorts, no other assets.
cost_accounting: Each rebalance charges round_trip_bps / 2 on the absolute weight traded in each leg (|dw_SPY| + |dw_BIL| = 2|dw|), i.e. round_trip_bps x |dw| of portfolio value. Buy-and-hold is charged one initial entry only.

controls.buy_and_hold: 100 percent SPY on identical periods; the Sharpe comparison.
controls.static_mix: Constant SPY weight equal to the strategy's realized average SPY weight, remainder BIL, rebalanced on the same grid with the same costs; the drawdown comparison, so a smaller drawdown cannot come from lower average exposure alone.

sharpe: Annualized mean / standard deviation of per-period returns in excess of BIL over the same period, x sqrt(252 / 5).
support_rationale: 2514 sessions less the 21-session warmup give about 498 non-overlapping 5-session periods, about 50 per calendar year.

acceptance.summary: All of: adequate support; positive 95 percent circular-block-bootstrap lower bound of Sharpe(strategy) - Sharpe(buy-and-hold) at 10 bps; strategy maximum drawdown at most 0.85 x the static mix's at 10 bps; positive Sharpe difference point estimate at 20 bps; average annual one-way turnover of SPY weight at most 4.0. CAGR, volatility, worst year, per-year Sharpe difference and the 6 bps tier are reported only.

preconditions: owner adopts a research-reset amendment and config/research_reset.json registered_trials cites this campaign_id
status set to registered and the contract registered under artifacts/volatility_target_core_trial_20261025/campaign_state.json before any price is read
daily acquisition manifest written with source hashes; timestamp-only support audit passes
non-claiming preflight passes: source hashes, 2016-2025 date bounds, no 2026 timestamp
stop_rule: Claim once immediately before weights are computed; no retry after a claim. A failed or inconclusive result retires this hypothesis and authorizes no tuning of target, lookback, band, rebalance interval, cap, assets or cost.
holdout_policy: The holdout is not read during development. After a pass, one untouched consistency check on 2026-09-09..2026-12-08 (about 12 periods) under the December 9 review plan; it cannot establish significance.
execution_assumption: Historical open-to-open markouts on adjusted prices with fixed costs; executable fills and per-fill fees are not established.
limitations: One equity index; results do not generalize to other assets without a separate contract.
2016-2025 contains three sharp sell-offs (2018 Q4, 2020 Q1, 2022) but mostly a strong bull market.
Volatility targeting is published and widely known; the test checks whether it held on this data after costs, not whether it is novel.
adjustment=all approximates total return; BIL approximates the cash return.
2024-2025 ETF data was viewed in earlier research; the development window is not untouched.
